steps.note: Open the prepared RFQ Responses screen with Vendor A and Vendor B bids.
Enable the required eRFX project configuration for the case.
Open the rejection dialog for Vendor A's bid.

args.text: Are you sure you want to reject this bid by Vendor A

steps.note: Confirm the dialog targets Vendor A's bid.

args.text: Supplier would not be allowed to bid again. This action cannot be undone.

steps.note: Verify the dialog warns that rebidding will be blocked when the option is left unticked.
Confirm the rejection without enabling seller rebidding.

args.text: You have blocked the supplier from bidding again.

steps.note: Verify Procol confirms the supplier was blocked from bidding again.
Verify the rejection reason is visible after the rejection.
Open the RFQ's Rejected Bids view.

args.text: Rejection Remark: Price not valid — QA

steps.note: Verify the rejected-bid record contains the submitted remark.
Navigate to Master QCS to inspect the post-rejection comparison.
Verify Vendor A has left the QCS and Vendor B is the remaining vendor column.
Verify the remaining vendor's ranking is still present after Vendor A's rejection.
Switch to Vendor A's supplier portal to inspect the vendor-side result.
Open the prepared event overview as Vendor A.
Check that Vendor A's portal indicates the bid was rejected.
